title: Structural and luminescent properties of Dy3+-doped Ca3WO6 phosphors for white-light display applications

Dy3+-doped Ca3WO6 phosphors, prepared via solid-state reaction, deliver brilliant white light with superior external quantum yield (∼59%), revolutionizing advanced display technologies with their monoclinic structure and optimal photoluminescence.
